notice: This work is being developed based on data published in the doctoral thesis by Esperanza Hernández Piedrahíta (USP, 2002). These are historical results, not current measurements of Taquaral Lake.

source.author: Esperanza Hernández Piedrahíta
source.title: Caracterização limnológica e estudo do processo de sedimentação e liberação de fósforo da Lagoa do Taquaral - Campinas (SP)
source.institution: University of São Paulo (USP), São Carlos School of Engineering
source.figure_processing: Figure 3 extracted from PDF page 45, with page margins cropped. Labels, colors and depth classes retained; no georeferencing or depth interpolation.

method: The thesis describes a shoreline topographic traverse using a total station and unidirectional transects with echo-sounder depth measurements every 20 meters. Original sounding coordinates, survey date and vertical reference have not been established from the reviewed material.

station_depth_discrepancy.resolution: Unresolved. Neither pair is used as verified georeferenced soundings.

limitations: No original georeferenced sounding dataset has been obtained.
The specific bathymetric survey date is unconfirmed; water sampling in 2000 does not establish the survey date.
The published depth map has not been georeferenced or digitized.
No underwater surface or current volume is inferred from these summary values.
Historical thesis geometry and the downloaded OpenStreetMap boundary use different sources and dates; their differences are not evidence of lake change.
Only Figure 3 is included for source-based study and analysis with attribution; the complete thesis PDF is not included. Consult the original source for its conditions of use.
release_scope: Published historical metrics, source figure, attribution, provenance, consistency notes and CSV/JSON exports. No underwater surface reconstruction.
